gloss_en: After updating the Revit IFC exporter, each distinct Assembly Code produces a separate IfcClassification instead of one.
title_original: Classifications
question_paraphrase: since the last update the export is wrong on classifications like Assembly Code; I get a different IfcClassification for every Assembly Code value
phrasing_notes: very short, no greeting, version regression comparison by commenters
answer_summary: Confirmed regression between 22.5.0.0 and 22.5.1.0 (issue still open).

gloss_en: Classification settings export fine with built-in exporter 2023.0.2 but not with open-source exporter 23.1.1; viewers show the same problem.
title_original: Revit 2023.1.1 classifications settings are not exported propperly
question_paraphrase: with the default exporter classification settings go into the IFC, with the open-source exporter 23.1.1 they do not; same in BIMvision, so not a Solibri issue
phrasing_notes: polite, asks 'are there more people with these issues?', misspelling 'propperly'
answer_summary: Exporter regression; one reply wrongly blamed Solibri, reporter showed BIMvision has same result.

gloss_en: Using Classification Manager with Uniclass creates separate number and description parameters, so IFC gets only one of them; how to get a good IFC?
title_original: Classification manager values to IFC
question_paraphrase: Classification Manager creates two parameters (number, description); the old manual way 'number : description' gave Identification and Name in IFC; now it doesn't work. Must I edit all the Excel tables?
phrasing_notes: asks follow-up whether COBie is used outside UK, German-speaking user
answer_summary: Suggested concatenating number:description into one parameter (COBie extension does this) and pointing the exporter at it.

gloss_en: We do not use Uniformat; how to stop it from always being exported as an IfcClassification?
title_original: Not possible to disable default Uniformat classification system?
question_paraphrase: we don't use Uniformat, how do I disable it from being exported? it seems to always be there
context_given: classification settings set to other system
phrasing_notes: two-sentence plea; commenter pasted raw IFCCLASSIFICATION STEP line
answer_summary: Still present as IFCCLASSIFICATION Uniformat 1998 line; appears when Assembly Code is non-empty.

gloss_en: Request: do not write Uniformat when Assembly Code is used for another classification; localised German parameter name fails.
title_original: ENH: Disable Uniformat classification if Assembly Code parameter is used for other classification system
question_paraphrase: Uniformat is irrelevant in many markets; we use Assembly Code with a custom classification file; need Uniformat suppressed. Tested in DEU UI, 'Baugruppenkennzeichen' does not work
answer_summary: Vendor said resolved; reporter tested and found localised parameter names still fail.

gloss_en: Let ClassificationName[name] (e.g. ClassificationNameCCI) define the system so the value can be simply 'BB:Foundation structure'.
title_original: ENH: get the classification system from the property name
question_paraphrase: currently multiple classifications need ClassificationName(n) format with strict value syntax; propose naming the system in the parameter name instead
answer_summary: Logged in Autodesk Jira as REVIT-252200, open.

gloss_en: Proposes native bSDD integration in Revit: classifications, properties, materials from project dictionaries, feeding IDS and pset name mapping.
title_original: ENH: bSDD integration
question_paraphrase: third-party bSDD integrations are clunky; wanted out of the box, like adding properties from shared parameter file but from enabled dictionaries
phrasing_notes: enthusiastic, links demo video, preempts 'is it used' question
answer_summary: Logged as REVIT-253211, open.

gloss_en: ClassificationCode[Type] on a wall type assigns the classification to the IfcWall occurrences, not the IfcWallType.
title_original: PR: ClassificationCode[Type] adds classification references to occurrences, not types
question_paraphrase: if I assign ClassificationCode[Type] to a type I expect it on IfcWallType; instead it lands on IfcWall. broken since 2021
answer_summary: Open (REVIT-235141); IfcOpenShell can repair afterwards.

gloss_en: How to fill all seven IfcClassification attributes (source, edition, date, location...) for multiple classifications from Revit parameters?
title_original: Not able to add IfcClassification metadtata for multiple classifications
question_paraphrase: with ClassificationCode(2) it is unclear how to add the extra IfcClassification attributes; the Reference:Name format only covers some
answer_summary: Value format [ClassificationCode]Reference:Name is parsed by ClassificationUtil; cannot fill all attributes.

gloss_en: How to set ClassificationName / ClassificationFieldName through IFCExportOptions from the API?
title_original: IFCExportOptions: set Classification Name and Classification field name from API
question_paraphrase: using AddOption ClassificationName and ClassificationFieldName from Python has no effect; data only exported when set from UI
answer_summary: Open as REVIT-246979; options undocumented.

gloss_en: Wants classification description support in Revit IFC export.
title_original: Classification Description
question_paraphrase: classification description not exported
answer_summary: Open since 2019.

gloss_en: IfcClassification has a flattened HasReferences hierarchy upon export.
title_original: IfcClassification has a flattened HasReferences hierarchy upon export
question_paraphrase: exported reference hierarchy is flat rather than nested
answer_summary: Open since 2020.

gloss_en: Classification attributes missing in IFC although specified in export settings.
title_original: Classification attributes missing when specified in export settings
question_paraphrase: classification attributes missing despite being set in export settings
answer_summary: Closed.

gloss_en: IFC exporter v22.6 vs 22.5.0 classification behaviour differs.
title_original: PR: IFC exporter v22.6.x vs 22.5.0 Classification
question_paraphrase: classification output changed between exporter versions
answer_summary: Closed.

gloss_en: Classification field is not written to both IFC4 formats.
title_original: (19.5.1.0 For Revit 2019) Classification field is not written to both IFC4 Formats
question_paraphrase: classification field not written in IFC4 formats
answer_summary: Closed.

gloss_en: Add Classification from bSDD crashes: IfcClassification.Location does not exist in IFC2X3.
title_original: bSDD issues
question_paraphrase: clicking Add Classification from bSDD gives a traceback at classification.Location = domain.namespace_uri
answer_summary: Fixed: IFC2X3 IfcClassification lacks Location; set via tool.Classification.set_location().

gloss_en: Error when classifying elements using bSDD (edit_pset crash on blank numeric value).
title_original: Error when classifying elements using bSDD
question_paraphrase: error when I classify elements with bSDD, traceback in edit_pset
answer_summary: Empty string for numeric property now treated as no value.

gloss_en: KeyError 'referenceCode' when adding a NL-SfB classification reference from bSDD.
title_original: bSDD KeyError: 'referenceCode when adding classification
question_paraphrase: stumbled across this: trying to add NL sfb reference from bSDD gives KeyError referenceCode
answer_summary: Open bug in Bonsai bSDD search.

gloss_en: Classification UI is confusing: only the most recently added IfcClassification can be used.
title_original: Classifications - UI/UX suggestions
question_paraphrase: I added several classifications but the dropdown only has one element; I expected all added IfcClassifications listed
answer_summary: Maintainer agreed UI is confusing.

gloss_en: Importing types from a library duplicates IfcClassification for each imported type.
title_original: Duplicate IfcClassification when importing a type from a library
question_paraphrase: importing types referencing the same IfcClassification creates a new duplicate IfcClassification each time
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: bSDD rate limit (HTTP 429) makes every classification say 'No bSDD Props Found'.
title_original: bSDD ratelimit in Bonsai
question_paraphrase: adding properties by bSDD classification says 'No bSDD Props Found' for every classification; API returns 429 rate limit
answer_summary: Retry/backoff fix not merged; still open.

gloss_en: Manual-entry classification reference fails with an error; turned out you must create IfcClassification first.
title_original: Bonsai: Error when creating manual classification entry
question_paraphrase: step list: new file, wall, Classification References, Manual Entry, Add Reference, type Identification/Name, Save - error
answer_summary: Create IfcClassification first, then reference; reporter asks for warning instead of error.

gloss_en: How to add the Brazilian SICLIC (ABNT NBR 15965) dictionary to the bSDD list when it is in Demo mode.
title_original: bsDD Dictionaries
question_paraphrase: manual entry didn't work; the dictionary is registered on the bSDD site but in Demo mode; can I add the JSON file or a link?
phrasing_notes: Portuguese speaker writing English, thanks at end
answer_summary: Use the bSDD management page to activate; confirmed working.

gloss_en: Is there a way to auto-assign external classifications (ÖNORM B 1801 cost groups) from IFC properties?
title_original: Automatic rule based classification
question_paraphrase: rule: non-external load-bearing IfcWalls get a given code; I wrote an ifcopenshell+IDS script but suspect a ready solution exists
answer_summary: bSDD cannot restrict classification by property values; only IDS can express class+property rules; a custom bSDD dictionary plus script was shared.

gloss_en: How to export IfcClassificationReference data to CSV; Uniclass code shows 'None' in ItemReference.
title_original: IfcCSV - How to export IfcClassificationReference data to CSV
question_paraphrase: docs unclear; with bare 'classification' column I get raw IFC line; with bSDD Uniclass references name exports but code is None
answer_summary: Use classification.Name / .Identification / .Location columns; None issue unanswered.

gloss_en: How are Uniclass 2015 references on entities and cost items shown in exported cost schedule CSV?
title_original: BBIM | Classification in Cost Schedule Exported .csv
question_paraphrase: assigning a Uniclass 2015 reference to entities and cost items, how does classification appear in the cost CSV
answer_summary: Not read in detail.

gloss_en: Why does an IfcClassificationReference belong to an IfcClassification with edition and metadata (matters for revised systems like Uniclass)?
title_original: IfcOpenShell add an IfcClassificationReference
question_paraphrase: a classification reference belongs to an IfcClassification that stores name, edition date and metadata
answer_summary: Explanation of edition-dated classification.

gloss_en: How do Uniclass, Uniformat and Omniclass relate to the IFC schema; do they map directly?
title_original: IFC Schema - ontology - semantic web
question_paraphrase: how do classification systems relate to IFC and do they map directly to the schema
answer_summary: Debated; mapping layer needed.

gloss_en: RFC about handling multiple classifications.
title_original: RFC: classification(s)
question_paraphrase: proposal for classification handling, table prefixes belong to systems like Uniclass, Uniformat, Omniclass
answer_summary: See thread.

gloss_en: Is there a guide and mapping table for using Uniclass 2015 properly in IFC (elements, systems, products)?
title_original: UNICLASS 2015 and Ifc
question_paraphrase: implemented classification with IfcClassification; is there a guide to use UNICLASS 2015 properly, ideally sample IFC, and an existing mapping table?
phrasing_notes: numbered questions, later sarcastic on NBS mapping
answer_summary: NBS publishes IFC2x3 mappings; many concepts not 1:1; BIMForum LOD spec maps Omniclass/Uniformat to Uniclass one way.

gloss_en: bSDD NL-SfB 22.21 maps to IfcWall LoadBearing=True/IsExternal=False but the class page leaves values empty.
title_original: bSDD classification mapping and specific pset values
question_paraphrase: NL-SfB example maps 22.21 to IFCWall with LoadBearing true, IsExternal false, but browsing the element those values are left open
answer_summary: Classification properties vs generic properties; mapping is three separate relations.

gloss_en: Should assets be IFC elements, OmniClass-classified, or both? Will IFC entities make classifications obsolete?
title_original: How does IFC work with existing classification systems such as Omniclass, Uniformat, etc?
question_paraphrase: model as IfcDoor, classify with OmniClass, or both? will growing IFC entity vocabulary make OmniClass obsolete
answer_summary: Layered approach: IFC class, predefined type, USERDEFINED ObjectType, then IfcClassificationReference; tool support uneven.

gloss_en: buildingSMART does not constrain IfcClassification values so exports differ; proposes a registry like EPSG.
title_original: Lack of standardisation of IfcClassification
question_paraphrase: same thing is described with different values by different authoring tools; propose published reference table of classification systems
answer_summary: Use URI as key; Graphisoft XML lists are not mappings; CCS and CoClass both ISO 81346.

gloss_en: Best IfcPipeFittingTypeEnum for a PVC reducing coupling: CONNECTOR or TRANSITION?
title_original: Best IFC classification for a reducing coupling
question_paraphrase: coupling joins two segments; with ports of different sizes should it be TRANSITION
answer_summary: Use TRANSITION when nominal diameter changes; MagiCAD does the same.

gloss_en: Revit IFC4.3 export puts everything under Building; can bSDD domain mapping fix this?
title_original: bSDD - buildingSMART Data Dictionary and classification of IFC 4x3 Domain mapping?
question_paraphrase: Revit IFC 4.3 export places elements under Building domain so infrastructure domains can't filter; could bSDD relationship mapping control it?
answer_summary: bSDD won't solve software implementation; Revit 2025 added facility-type assignment.

gloss_en: Do custom shared parameters need to be in the 'IFC Parameters' group for IfcExportAs / Classification Manager export?
title_original: "IFC Parameters" in Revit
question_paraphrase: land surveyor new to IFC; should instance parameters be grouped under IFC Parameters when exporting via IfcExportAs, mapping or Classification Manager
answer_summary: Group names become pset names; user-defined pset mapping txt recommended.

gloss_en: How do producers get a bSDD GUID for national classification and is bSDD GUID the same as IFC GUID?
title_original: Bsdd access for products and classification standard / bsdd guid vs ifc guid
question_paraphrase: who links national products to IFC via bSDD; must each implementer build the connection; is bSDD GUID the same as IFC GUID
answer_summary: Property/pset GUIDs match IFC definitions; core question unanswered.

gloss_en: Can a garbage disposal + P-trap be one IfcElementAssembly ACCESSORY_ASSEMBLY, and can Revit set ObjectType?
title_original: Best classification for an assembly
question_paraphrase: model garbage disposal and trap as single element assembly; USERDEFINED ObjectType in Revit not settable
answer_summary: Allowed; USERDEFINED + ObjectType suggested.
